title: push::StateChange shared by SSE and WS: DRY at the type level
description: Both SseEvent::StateChange and WsFrame::StateChange carry the same push::StateChange type. This means callers writing StateChange-handling code do not need to branch on transport. A contributor might suggest separate SseStateChange and WsStateChange types for 'clarity' or to allow transport-specific fields. However, RFC 8620 §7.1 defines StateChange with identical shape for both transports; diverging the types would create false differences and force callers to duplicate handling. The shared type is intentional and correct.
